title: Financial Overview
description: Overview of your financial status with net worth, assets, liabilities, and breakdowns

steps.query: SELECT currency, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM (SELECT p.currency AS currency, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL)) AS amount FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON p.currency = c.code WHERE c.is_currency = 1 AND p.account_type IN ('Assets', 'Liabilities') GROUP BY p.currency UNION ALL SELECT l.cost_currency AS currency, SUM(CASE WHEN lp.price IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(l.units_number AS REAL) * lp.price ELSE CAST(l.book_value AS REAL) END) AS amount FROM lots l JOIN commodities c ON c.code = l.units_currency AND c.is_currency = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = x.quote_currency)) lp ON lp.base_currency = l.units_currency AND lp.quote_currency = l.cost_currency GROUP BY l.cost_currency) GROUP BY currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY currency

SELECT currency, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM (SELECT p.currency AS currency, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL)) AS amount FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON p.currency = c.code WHERE c.is_currency = 1 AND p.account_type = 'Assets' GROUP BY p.currency UNION ALL SELECT l.cost_currency AS currency, SUM(CASE WHEN lp.price IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(l.units_number AS REAL) * lp.price ELSE CAST(l.book_value AS REAL) END) AS amount FROM lots l JOIN commodities c ON c.code = l.units_currency AND c.is_currency = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = x.quote_currency)) lp ON lp.base_currency = l.units_currency AND lp.quote_currency = l.cost_currency GROUP BY l.cost_currency) GROUP BY currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY currency

SELECT currency, SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * -1 AS amount FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON p.currency = c.code WHERE c.is_currency = 1 AND account_type = 'Liabilities' GROUP BY currency HAVING amount != 0 ORDER BY currency

widgets.title: Assets Breakdown
widgets.helpText: Only shows accounts with a positive balance. Accounts with negative balances (e.g. overdrawn) are excluded since pie charts cannot display negative values.

steps.query: SELECT CASE WHEN v.account LIKE 'Assets:Liquid:%' THEN REPLACE(v.account, 'Assets:Liquid:', '') WHEN v.account LIKE 'Assets:Investments:%' THEN REPLACE(v.account, 'Assets:Investments:', '') ELSE REPLACE(v.account, 'Assets:', '') END AS name, v.account AS account, ROUND(SUM(v.value), 2) AS value FROM (SELECT p.account AS account, SUM(CAST(p.amount AS REAL)) AS value FROM postings p JOIN commodities c ON p.currency = c.code WHERE p.account_type = 'Assets' AND c.is_currency = 1 AND p.currency = :currency GROUP BY p.account UNION ALL SELECT l.account AS account, SUM(CASE WHEN lp.price IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(l.units_number AS REAL) * lp.price ELSE CAST(l.book_value AS REAL) END) AS value FROM lots l JOIN commodities c ON c.code = l.units_currency AND c.is_currency = 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT base_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.quote_currency = :currency AND x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = :currency)) lp ON lp.base_currency = l.units_currency WHERE l.cost_currency = :currency GROUP BY l.account) v JOIN accounts a ON a.name = v.account WHERE a.close_date IS NULL GROUP BY v.account HAVING ROUND(SUM(v.value), 2) >= 0.01 ORDER BY value DESC

widgets.title: Liabilities Breakdown
widgets.helpText: Only shows accounts with outstanding balances. Accounts with negative balances (e.g. overpayment or refund) are excluded since pie charts cannot display negative values.

steps.query: SELECT REPLACE(account, 'Liabilities:', '') AS name, account, ROUND(SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * -1, 2) AS value FROM postings WHERE account_type = 'Liabilities' AND currency = :currency GROUP BY account HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC
